skillNames.percentages: Percent, percent change and successive percents

template.name: reverse_percent
misconceptions: undoing a percent with the opposite percent

concept: Successive percent changes multiply; to undo them, divide by the multipliers.

stem: A store discounts a jacket by $20\%$. Then a $6\%$ sales tax is added to the discounted price. The final price is $\$76.32$.
question.prompt: What was the original price of the jacket?

choices.label: A
choices.note: opposite percents applied to the final price
choices.why: This applies the opposite percents to the final price: $76.32 \times 1.2 \times 0.94 \approx 86.09$, rounded to the nearest cent. Undoing a $20\%$ discount means dividing by $0.8$, not multiplying by $1.2$.
choices.rationale: Undoes each change with the opposite percent.

choices.label: B
choices.why: This treats the changes as one $14\%$ decrease: $76.32 \div 0.86 \approx 88.74$, rounded to the nearest cent. Successive percents multiply instead: $0.8 \times 1.06 = 0.848$.

choices.label: D
choices.why: This undoes only the discount, treating the final price as if it were the price before tax: $95.40 \times 0.8 = 76.32$. The $6\%$ tax was also added, so it must be undone too.
choices.rationale: Undoes one of the two changes.

steps.title: Careful: the percents do not combine
steps.caption: **Careful:** this is **not** $14\%$ off. The $20\%$ comes off the **original** price; the $6\%$ tax is added to the smaller, **discounted** price.

steps.title: Each change is a multiplier
steps.caption: With $P$ the original price: $20\%$ off leaves $80\%$, and $6\%$ tax makes $106\%$.

steps.title: Calculator time
steps.caption: **Calculator:** setting up the equation is the skill. Let the calculator do the decimals.

steps.title: The trap: adding the percents
steps.caption: **The trap:** $14\%$ off would multiply by $0.86$, not by $0.848$.

solution.keyIdea: Percent changes **multiply**. To undo them, divide by the multipliers.
solution.summary: The discount and the tax apply to different amounts, so they do not combine to 14% off. 0.8 × 1.06 × P = 76.32. With a calculator, P = 76.32 / (0.8 × 1.06) = 90. Check: 90 × 0.8 = 72 and 72 × 1.06 = 76.32.

meta.description_lead: 20% off, then 6% tax, total $76.32. Original price?

timing.rule: first whole second at or after the end of the thinking countdown; never after the first spoken explanation sentence
